Black-Box Optimization Benchmarking (BBOB)

This benchmark evaluates Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) variants against the BlackBoxOptimizationBenchmarking.jl suite, using the Optimization.jl interface.

Phase 1 (this benchmark): Run everything on CPU with the original BBOB functions to find the best PSO configuration that matches established optimizers on convergence.

Phase 2 (next): Take the winning config, switch CPU() → CUDABackend(), crank particles to 10⁵+, and show the same convergence in a fraction of wall time.

Setup

using BlackBoxOptimizationBenchmarking, CairoMakie, Optimization, Memoize, Statistics
import BlackBoxOptimizationBenchmarking: Chain, BenchmarkSetup, BenchmarkResults,
    BBOBFunction, FunctionCallsCounter, solve_problem, pinit, compute_CI
const BBOB = BlackBoxOptimizationBenchmarking

using OptimizationBBO, OptimizationOptimJL, OptimizationNLopt
using OptimizationSciPy

using ParallelParticleSwarms
using KernelAbstractions: CPU
using StaticArrays, LinearAlgebra

const PSOKernel     = ParallelParticleSwarms.ParallelPSOKernel
const SyncPSOKernel = ParallelParticleSwarms.ParallelSyncPSOKernel
const SerPSO        = ParallelParticleSwarms.SerialPSO
const HPso          = ParallelParticleSwarms.HybridPSO

ParallelParticleSwarms.HybridPSO

CPU Baselines

chain = (t; isboxed = false) -> Chain(
    BenchmarkSetup(t, isboxed = isboxed),
    BenchmarkSetup(NelderMead(), isboxed = false),
    0.9)

test_functions = BBOB.list_functions()
dimension = 3
run_length = round.(Int, 10 .^ LinRange(1, 5, 20))

cpu_setup = Dict(
    "NelderMead" => NelderMead(),
    "NLopt.GN_CRS2_LM()" => chain(NLopt.GN_CRS2_LM(), isboxed = true),
    "BBO_adaptive_de_rand_1_bin" => chain(BBO_adaptive_de_rand_1_bin(), isboxed = true),
    "BBO_adaptive_de_rand_1_bin_radiuslimited" => chain(
        BBO_adaptive_de_rand_1_bin_radiuslimited(), isboxed = true),
    "BBO_de_rand_2_bin" => chain(BBO_de_rand_2_bin(), isboxed = true),
    "ScipyDifferentialEvolution" => chain(ScipyDifferentialEvolution(), isboxed = true),
)

cpu_labels = sort(collect(keys(cpu_setup)))

@memoize run_cpu_bench(algo) = BBOB.benchmark(
    cpu_setup[algo], test_functions, run_length, Ntrials = 20, dimension = dimension)

cpu_results = Dict{String, BenchmarkResults}()
for algo in cpu_labels
    @info "CPU: $algo ..."
    cpu_results[algo] = run_cpu_bench(algo)
    @info "  done" success=round(cpu_results[algo].success_rate[end], digits = 3)
end

PSO on CPU

const Δf_pso = 1e-6

function pso_solve(opt, f::BBOBFunction, D::Int, maxiters::Int; local_maxiters::Int = 30)
    obj = (x, p) -> f.f(x)
    ad = opt isa HPso ? AutoForwardDiff() : Optimization.SciMLBase.NoAD()
    optf = OptimizationFunction{false}(obj, ad)
    lb = SVector{D}(ntuple(_ -> -5.0, Val(D)))
    ub = SVector{D}(ntuple(_ ->  5.0, Val(D)))
    x0 = SVector{D}(ntuple(_ -> -5.0 + rand() * 10.0, Val(D)))
    prob = OptimizationProblem{false}(optf, x0, nothing; lb = lb, ub = ub)
    
    if opt isa HPso
        solve(prob, opt; maxiters = maxiters, local_maxiters = local_maxiters, maxtime = 2.0)
    else
        solve(prob, opt; maxiters = maxiters, maxtime = 2.0)
    end
end
function pso_benchmark(opt, funcs, run_length;
        Ntrials = 20, dimension = 3, local_maxiters = 30, Δf = 1e-6, CI_quantile = 0.25)
    Nf = length(funcs)
    Nr = length(run_length)
    success = zeros(Float64, Nf, Nr)
    dist    = zeros(Float64, Nf, Nr)
    fmin    = zeros(Float64, Nf, Nr)
    counts  = zeros(Float64, Nf, Nr)

    t0 = time()
    for (fi, f) in enumerate(funcs)
        try pso_solve(opt, f, dimension, 5; local_maxiters) catch; end
        for (ri, rl) in enumerate(run_length)
            hits = 0; dsum = 0.0; fsum = 0.0
            for _ in 1:Ntrials
                sol = try pso_solve(opt, f, dimension, rl; local_maxiters) catch; nothing end
                if sol !== nothing
                    u = sol.u isa SVector ? sol.u : sol.u[]
                    fval = sol.objective isa Real ? Float64(sol.objective) : Float64(sol.objective[])
                    ok = abs(fval - f.f_opt) < Δf
                    hits += ok ? 1 : 0
                    dsum += norm(u .- f.x_opt[1:dimension])
                    fsum += fval - f.f_opt
                end
            end
            success[fi, ri] = hits / Ntrials
            dist[fi, ri]    = dsum / Ntrials
            fmin[fi, ri]    = fsum / Ntrials
        end
    end
    elapsed = time() - t0

    Neff = Ntrials * Nf
    sr   = vec(mean(success, dims = 1))
    sc   = vec(sum(success .* Ntrials, dims = 1)) .|> round .|> Int

    ci = BBOB.compute_CI(sr, Neff, CI_quantile)

    BenchmarkResults(
        run_length     = collect(run_length),
        success_count  = sc,
        success_rate   = sr,
        success_rate_qlow  = ci.success_rate_qlow,
        success_rate_qhigh = ci.success_rate_qhigh,
        distance_to_minimizer = vec(mean(dist, dims = 1)),
        minimum        = vec(mean(fmin, dims = 1)),
        runtime        = elapsed,
        Neffective     = Neff,
        callcount      = Float64.(run_length),   # PSO doesn't track call count separately
        success_rate_per_function = [success[fi, end] for fi in 1:Nf],
    )
end

pso_benchmark (generic function with 1 method)

num_particles = 250

pso_setup = Dict(
    "SerialPSO"             => (SerPSO(num_particles), 30),
    "PSOKernel sync"        => (PSOKernel(num_particles; backend = CPU(), global_update = true), 30),
    "SyncPSOKernel"         => (SyncPSOKernel(num_particles; backend = CPU()), 30),
    "HybridPSO-LBFGS lm30"  => (HPso(pso = PSOKernel(num_particles; backend = CPU()); backend = CPU()), 30),
)

pso_labels = sort(collect(keys(pso_setup)))

@memoize run_pso_bench(algo) = begin
    opt, lm = pso_setup[algo]
    pso_benchmark(opt, test_functions, run_length;
        Ntrials = 20, dimension = dimension, local_maxiters = lm)
end

pso_results = Dict{String, BenchmarkResults}()
for algo in pso_labels
    @info "PSO: $algo ..."
    try
        pso_results[algo] = run_pso_bench(algo)
        @info "  done" success=round(pso_results[algo].success_rate[end], digits = 3)
    catch err
        @warn "$algo failed, skipping" exception=(err, catch_backtrace())
    end
end

available_pso = [l for l in pso_labels if haskey(pso_results, l)]
@info "PSO completed" n=length(available_pso) labels=available_pso

Success Rate vs. Iterations

all_labels  = vcat(cpu_labels, available_pso)
all_results = vcat(
    [cpu_results[l] for l in cpu_labels],
    [pso_results[l] for l in available_pso])

idx = sortperm([r.success_rate[end] for r in all_results], rev = true)

fig = Figure(size = (1000, 550))
ax = Axis(fig[1, 1],
    xlabel = "Total function evaluations", ylabel = "Success rate",
    title = "BBOB 3D: Success rate vs iterations",
    xscale = log10, limits = (10, 1e5, 0, 1.05))

for (rank, i) in enumerate(idx)
    r = all_results[i]
    style = all_labels[i] in available_pso ? :dash : :solid
    lines!(ax, Float64.(r.run_length), r.success_rate,
        label = all_labels[i], linestyle = style, linewidth = 2)
end
Legend(fig[1, 2], ax, framevisible = false, labelsize = 10)
fig

Success Rate per Function Heatmap

all_srpf = reduce(hcat, r.success_rate_per_function for r in all_results)
func_names = string.(test_functions)

idx = sortperm(mean(all_srpf, dims = 1)[:], rev = false)

fig = Figure(size = (1000, 700))
ax = Axis(fig[1, 1],
    title = "Per-function success rate at max budget",
    xticks = (1:length(func_names), func_names),
    yticks = (1:length(all_labels), all_labels[idx]),
    xticklabelrotation = π/4)

heatmap!(ax, all_srpf[:, idx]', colormap = :RdYlGn, colorrange = (0, 1))
Colorbar(fig[1, 2], colormap = :RdYlGn, limits = (0, 1), label = "Success rate")
fig

Distance to Minimizer vs. Iterations

idx = sortperm([r.distance_to_minimizer[end] for r in all_results], rev = false)

fig = Figure(size = (1000, 550))
ax = Axis(fig[1, 1],
    xlabel = "Total function evaluations", ylabel = "Mean distance to minimum",
    title = "BBOB 3D: Distance to minimizer",
    xscale = log10, limits = (10, 1e5, 0, 5))

for (rank, i) in enumerate(idx)
    r = all_results[i]
    style = all_labels[i] in available_pso ? :dash : :solid
    lines!(ax, Float64.(r.run_length), r.distance_to_minimizer,
        label = all_labels[i], linestyle = style, linewidth = 2)
end
Legend(fig[1, 2], ax, framevisible = false, labelsize = 10)
fig

Relative Runtime

all_runtimes = [r.runtime for r in all_results]
ref = findfirst("NelderMead" .== all_labels)
runtimes_rel = all_runtimes ./ all_runtimes[ref]

fig = Figure(size = (1000, 550))
ax = Axis(fig[1, 1],
    ylabel = "Runtime relative to NelderMead",
    title = "BBOB 3D: Relative runtime",
    yscale = log10,
    xticks = (1:length(all_labels), all_labels),
    xticklabelrotation = π/4)

barplot!(ax, 1:length(all_labels), runtimes_rel)
fig

Summary

println("\n", "="^70)
println("CONVERGENCE RANKING (success rate at max budget)")
println("="^70)

all_sr = [(all_labels[i], all_results[i].success_rate[end]) for i in 1:length(all_labels)]
sort!(all_sr, by = x -> -x[2])

for (rank, (name, sr)) in enumerate(all_sr)
    tag = name in available_pso ? " ← PSO" : ""
    println("  $(lpad(rank, 2)). $(rpad(name, 45)) $(round(sr * 100, digits = 1))%$tag")
end

println("\n", "="^70)
println("Best PSO variant for GPU promotion:")
best_pso = argmax(Dict(l => pso_results[l].success_rate[end] for l in available_pso))
println("  → $best_pso ($(round(pso_results[best_pso].success_rate[end] * 100, digits = 1))%)")
println("="^70)
